Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Stop an agent trying to wipe the root folder

What happens

rm -rf of a path that starts with an unset variable. The call below tries to wipe the root folder. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves the file system.

The call

rm -rf "$UNSET_DIR/"

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

In shell scripts, write ${VAR:?} before a deletion, as in rm -rf "${BUILD_DIR:?}/", so the script stops when the variable is empty or unset. Also start scripts with set -u.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule rm-root-home, first stopped in version 0.33.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
